headline: CCNY finishes atop CUNYAC as its only winning side
dek: CCNY won eight matches against six losses and one draw, claiming more victories than any other CUNYAC program. Scoring 38 goals while conceding 34 across all matches, CCNY posted the conference's only winning overall record as John Jay and Brooklyn College gave chase and York (N.Y.) never took the field.

pattern.text: Attacking output splits the conference sharply between its active top tier and the bottom of the chart, where John Jay's 51 goals outpace the combined totals of CCNY, Medgar Evers College, and York (N.Y.).
